scope: Character preset to Awoken relationship coverage
policy: Do not infer preset Awoken skills from character identity, transformations shown in external summaries, or wish-list/community material. Populate canonical_awoken_id only when the preset loadout is directly evidenced.
external_context: Partner customization documentation demonstrates that character skill sets can contain an Awoken slot, but this does not establish every default preset's Awoken loadout.
Future Saga Chapter 4 documentation establishes The Power to Overcome as a CaC Awoken Skill and DLC content, but does not by itself establish a specific default character preset loadout.
